title: Carshigii Ku Safray Isla Markiiba
intro: Shaqad awood badan leh ayaa ka talin jirtay boqortooyo hodan ah oo lagu barakeeyey hanti aan la qiyaasi karin. Markii caqabad lama filaan ah ay soo baxday, taliyahani wuxuu la kulmay tijaabo aan seefo ahayn laakiin xigmad iyo iimaan. Waxa dhacay waxay ka bilaabi doonaan awoodda adduunka ugu sarreysa una horseedi doonaan isbeddel qoto dheer oo qalbi ah.
clues: Waxaan xukumay boqortooyo ay ku barakoobeen maal iyo barwaaqo aan la qiyaasi karin
Waxaan ahaa boqor awood badan oo helay warqad geesinimo leh oo dalbanaysa in la ii gudbiyo
Dadka sharafta leh ayaa igala taliyay inaan la dagaallamo ama aan nabad la sameeyo boqorkan fog.
Waxaan u baxay hadiyado cajiib ah si aan aniga qudhaydu ula kulmo boqorkan fog
Carshigaygii boqortooyada waxaa la geeyay dhul fog iyadoo ilbiriqsi ah, ka hor intaanan soo laaban.
Markii aan galay qasri dabaq siman sida muraayad oo kale ah, ugu dambayntii waxaan ku dhawaaqay inaan Alle u hoggaansamay

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
